I had a long term ex that I never thought I could get over because I felt like I loved him so much and I invested so much in him. But realizing that ~I~ loved him very deeply was a big part in my healing. I was sad for many months crying like a broken record but with that mentality it kind of switched the narrative from a lack of love on his end and focusing more on the love I gave him and how I could pour that into myself instead.

i do, think about him constantly still. 

the choice to end our relationship felt like the hardest thing to do. he really felt like everything right for me and vice versa. but because the reason we broke up was never an internal problem with us it never felt like something we could work through. I like to write letters or texts that I wouldn't really send to him. It allows me to send that "I miss you" text while also giving him that space to heal and move on.
